answer: At dawn a numbered raven leaves an orchard gate; the holder photographs it against the horizon mid-flight, and the keeper logs its flight time on the leg-band number with the date; two verifiers return in 24 hours, release a second raven from the same gate and match the flight line and band number; a raven that turns back or a duplicate band number locks and burns the deposit; 100 fakes need 100 ravens and 100 dawn orchard trips.
